pages.text: A fury rod and shiver tooth can be crafted into a special arrow. Claim arrows only deal half damage, but they mark your claim over those you best in combat, giving you power over your foes.

If you hit a mob with a claim arrow while holding a spindle in your off-hand, the spindle will become bloodied, entangled with that mob (so long as the mob is in a loaded chunk).$(br2)If you hit the mob thrice without missing or getting hurt by it, you will be able to expend the spindle to summon the mob.$(br2)After nine hits, you can toss the spindle into a block focus and it will act as if the mob were in that focus.
